<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>M+K ❤️</title>
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#c0395a">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Para Maria">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon-180.png">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=Lato:wght@300;400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--rose:#c0395a;--blush:#f7c5d2;--cream:#fff8f0;--gold:#d4a853;--deep:#0d0508;--purple:#8b4a9a;}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
body{background:var(--deep);font-family:"Lato",sans-serif;min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;color:var(--cream);}

/* BG Slideshow */
#bg-slideshow{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;}
.bg-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.5s ease;filter:blur(4px) brightness(0.25);}
.bg-slide.active{opacity:1;}
#bg-slideshow::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d050888 0%,#0d0508bb 50%,#0d0508ff 100%);z-index:1;}

/* Petals */
.petals{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;overflow:hidden;}
.petal{position:absolute;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 30%,#f7c5d2,#c0395a88);border-radius:50% 0 50% 0;animation:fall linear infinite;opacity:0;}
@keyframes fall{0%{transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0deg);opacity:.7}100%{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(360deg);opacity:0}}

/* App */
.app{position:relative;z-index:3;max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 14px 80px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:20px;}

/* Header */
header{text-align:center;padding-top:16px;width:100%;}
.app-name{font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,7vw,2.6rem);font-style:italic;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--blush));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
.app-subtitle{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rose);margin-top:5px;opacity:.8;}
.heart-icon{font-size:2.2rem;animation:pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;display:block;margin:10px auto 4px;cursor:pointer;}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.25)}}

/* Who am I bar */
.who-bar{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(58,10,32,.7);border:1px solid #c0395a33;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 14px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);}
.who-label{font-size:.72rem;color:#c0395a88;white-space:nowrap;}
.who-btn{flex:1;padding:8px;background:transparent;border:1px solid #c0395a33;border-radius:20px;color:#c0395a88;font-size:.78rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;text-align:center;}
.who-btn.active{background:var(--rose);color:#fff;border-color:var(--rose);font-weight:700;}

/* Counters */
.counter-card{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(58,10,32,.88),rgba(31,10,20,.92));border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:20px;padding:18px 20px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 0 30px #d4a85322;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);}
.counter-card.apart{border-color:var(--purple);}
.counter-label{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px;}
.counter-card.apart .counter-label{color:#d4a0e8;}
.counter-numbers{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.counter-unit{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;}
.counter-num{font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;font-size:1.9rem;color:var(--blush);line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 20px #c0395a88;}
.counter-card.apart .counter-num{color:#e8c4f8;text-shadow:0 0 20px #8b4a9a88;}
.counter-name{font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rose);opacity:.8;}
.counter-card.apart .counter-name{color:#d4a0e8;}
.counter-sep{font-size:1.3rem;color:#c0395a33;align-self:center;}
.counter-since{margin-top:8px;font-size:.72rem;color:#c0395a88;font-style:italic;}
.counter-card.apart .counter-since{color:#8b4a9a88;}

/* Photo strip */
.photo-strip{width:100%;display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 2px;scrollbar-width:none;}
.photo-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.photo-strip img{height:80px;width:64px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid #c0395a33;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.photo-strip img:hover{border-color:var(--rose);transform:scale(1.07);}

/* Music */
.music-card{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(42,10,26,.92),rgba(31,13,22,.95));border:1px solid #c0395a55;border-radius:20px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);}
.music-disc{width:46px;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),#8b1a34);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.3rem;flex-shrink:0;}
.music-disc.spinning{animation:spin 3s linear infinite;}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.music-text{flex:1;overflow:hidden;}
.music-title{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--blush);font-style:italic;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.music-sub{font-size:.63rem;color:#c0395a88;margin-top:2px;}
.music-wave{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;height:18px;margin-right:4px;}
.music-wave span{width:3px;background:var(--rose);border-radius:2px;height:3px;}
.music-wave.on span{animation:wave .7s ease-in-out infinite;}
.music-wave.on span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}.music-wave.on span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s}.music-wave.on span:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.36s}
@keyframes wave{0%,100%{height:3px}50%{height:16px}}
.music-btn{width:40px;height:40px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),#8b1a34);border:none;border-radius:50%;color:#fff;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 2px 12px #c0395a55;transition:transform .2s;}
.music-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.1);}

/* Chat */
.chat-wrap{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1a0609,#110408);border:1px solid #c0395a44;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;}
.chat-header{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3a0a20,#2a0a18);padding:12px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #c0395a33;}
.chat-avatar{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),#8b1a34);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;flex-shrink:0;}
.chat-name-h{font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;font-size:.92rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--blush);}
.chat-online{font-size:.63rem;color:#4ade8088;letter-spacing:1px;}
.chat-call-btns{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-left:auto;}
.call-btn{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1rem;transition:all .2s;}
.call-btn.audio{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a7a3a,#0d4a22);}
.call-btn.video{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a3a7a,#0d224a);}
.call-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.1);}
.conn-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#f87171;margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;}
.conn-dot.ok{background:#4ade80;}

.chat-messages{height:340px;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;scroll-behavior:smooth;}
.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px;}
.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#c0395a44;border-radius:4px;}

.msg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-width:82%;animation:msgIn .22s ease;}
@keyframes msgIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.msg.me{align-self:flex-end;align-items:flex-end;}
.msg.her{align-self:flex-start;align-items:flex-start;}
.msg-bubble{padding:9px 13px;border-radius:16px;font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.55;word-break:break-word;}
.msg.me .msg-bubble{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b1a34,#5a0f22);border-bottom-right-radius:4px;color:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 2px 10px #c0395a33;}
.msg.her .msg-bubble{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a0f1a,#1f0a14);border:1px solid #c0395a33;border-bottom-left-radius:4px;color:var(--blush);}
.msg-bubble img{max-width:100%;border-radius:10px;display:block;margin-top:4px;max-height:200px;object-fit:cover;cursor:pointer;}
.msg-time{font-size:.6rem;color:#c0395a66;margin-top:3px;padding:0 2px;}
.msg-sender{font-size:.63rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:3px;font-style:italic;}
.uploading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px;background:#2a0f1a;border-radius:16px;font-size:.8rem;color:#c0395a88;font-style:italic;}
.upload-spin{width:14px;height:14px;border:2px solid #c0395a44;border-top-color:var(--rose);border-radius:50%;animation:uspin .7s linear infinite;flex-shrink:0;}
@keyframes uspin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

.chat-input-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;background:#1a0609;border-top:1px solid #c0395a22;}
.chat-input{flex:1;min-height:unset;height:42px;border-radius:21px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:.88rem;background:#0f0508;border:1px solid #c0395a44;color:var(--cream);outline:none;}
.chat-input:focus{border-color:var(--rose);}
.chat-input::placeholder{color:#c0395a55;font-style:italic;}
.chat-send{width:42px;height:42px;flex-shrink:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),#8b1a34);border:none;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1rem;transition:all .2s;box-shadow:0 2px 10px #c0395a44;}
.chat-send:hover{transform:scale(1.1);}
.chat-photo-btn{width:42px;height:42px;flex-shrink:0;background:#0f0508;border:1px solid #c0395a44;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;transition:all .2s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.chat-photo-btn:hover{border-color:var(--rose);}
.chat-photo-btn input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;width:100%;height:100%;}

/* Call overlay */
#call-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:400;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#0d0508ee;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);}
#call-overlay.open{display:flex;}
.call-screen{width:100%;max-width:400px;padding:30px 20px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:16px;}
.call-avatar{width:90px;height:90px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),#8b1a34);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.5rem;margin:0 auto;box-shadow:0 0 40px #c0395a55;animation:callpulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes callpulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 20px #c0395a55}50%{box-shadow:0 0 50px #c0395a99}}
.call-name{font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--blush);}
.call-status{font-size:.8rem;color:#c0395a88;letter-spacing:2px;}
.call-timer{font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--gold);font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;display:none;}
#local-video{position:absolute;bottom:140px;right:20px;width:100px;height:140px;border-radius:12px;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--rose);display:none;z-index:5;}
#remote-video{width:100%;max-width:400px;height:280px;border-radius:16px;object-fit:cover;background:#1a0609;display:none;border:1px solid #c0395a44;}
.call-actions{display:flex;gap:20px;justify-content:center;margin-top:10px;}
.call-action-btn{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.4rem;transition:all .2s;}
.call-action-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.1);}
.btn-hangup{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dc2626,#991b1b);}
.btn-mute{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#374151,#1f2937);}
.btn-cam{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a3a7a,#0d224a);}

/* Incoming call */
#incoming-call{position:fixed;top:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:450;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a0f1a,#1f0a14);border:1px solid var(--rose);border-radius:20px;padding:16px 20px;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:280px;box-shadow:0 8px 40px #c0395a55;animation:slideDown .3s ease;}
@keyframes slideDown{from{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-20px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);opacity:1}}
#incoming-call.open{display:flex;}
.incoming-title{font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;font-size:1rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--blush);}
.incoming-sub{font-size:.75rem;color:#c0395a88;}
.incoming-btns{display:flex;gap:12px;}
.incoming-btn{padding:10px 22px;border:none;border-radius:20px;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.incoming-accept{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a7a3a,#0d4a22);color:#fff;}
.incoming-decline{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7a1a1a,#4a0d0d);color:#fff;}

/* Lightbox */
#lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000000ee;z-index:500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
#lightbox img{max-width:95vw;max-height:90vh;border-radius:12px;}
#lightbox.open{display:flex;}

/* Notification toast */
#toast{position:fixed;top:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:460;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a0f1a,#1f0a14);border:1px solid var(--rose);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 18px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:260px;max-width:340px;box-shadow:0 4px 20px #c0395a44;animation:slideDown .3s ease;}
#toast.open{display:flex;}
.toast-icon{font-size:1.3rem;flex-shrink:0;}
.toast-text{flex:1;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--blush);}
.toast-close{color:#c0395a66;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;padding:2px;}

/* Burst */
.burst{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:999;}
.burst-heart{position:absolute;font-size:1.3rem;animation:burstA 1s ease-out forwards;}
@keyframes burstA{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(0);opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(1.2);opacity:0}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="bg-slideshow"></div>
<div class="petals" id="petals"></div>
<div id="lightbox" onclick="this.classList.remove('open')"><img id="lb-img" src="" alt=""></div>
<video id="local-video" autoplay muted playsinline></video>

<!-- Incoming call -->
<div id="incoming-call">
  <div class="incoming-title">📞 Chamada entrando...</div>
  <div class="incoming-sub" id="incoming-sub">Maria está ligando 💕</div>
  <div class="incoming-btns">
    <button class="incoming-btn incoming-accept" onclick="acceptCall()">✅ Atender</button>
    <button class="incoming-btn incoming-decline" onclick="declineCall()">❌ Recusar</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Call overlay -->
<div id="call-overlay">
  <div class="call-screen">
    <div class="call-avatar" id="call-avatar">🌹</div>
    <div class="call-name">Maria</div>
    <div class="call-status" id="call-status">chamando...</div>
    <div class="call-timer" id="call-timer">00:00</div>
    <video id="remote-video" autoplay playsinline></video>
    <div class="call-actions">
      <button class="call-action-btn btn-mute" id="btn-mute" onclick="toggleMute()" title="Mudo">🎤</button>
      <button class="call-action-btn btn-hangup" onclick="hangUp()" title="Desligar">📵</button>
      <button class="call-action-btn btn-cam" id="btn-cam" onclick="toggleCam()" title="Câmera" style="display:none">📷</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Toast -->
<div id="toast">
  <div class="toast-icon" id="toast-icon">💕</div>
  <div class="toast-text" id="toast-text"></div>
  <div class="toast-close" onclick="closeToast()">✕</div>
</div>

<div class="app">
  <header>
    <span class="heart-icon" id="heart-icon">❤️</span>
    <div class="app-name">Para Minha Maria</div>
    <div class="app-subtitle">com todo o meu amor</div>
  </header>

  <!-- Who am I -->
  <div class="who-bar">
    <div class="who-label">Eu sou:</div>
    <button class="who-btn active" id="who-me" onclick="setWho('me')">💙 Eu (Kadu)</button>
    <button class="who-btn" id="who-her" onclick="setWho('her')">🌹 Maria</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Contador juntos -->
  <div class="counter-card">
    <div class="counter-label">💍 Juntos há</div>
    <div class="counter-numbers">
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="j-a">0</div><div class="counter-name">anos</div></div>
      <div class="counter-sep">·</div>
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="j-m">0</div><div class="counter-name">meses</div></div>
      <div class="counter-sep">·</div>
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="j-d">0</div><div class="counter-name">dias</div></div>
      <div class="counter-sep">·</div>
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="j-h">0</div><div class="counter-name">horas</div></div>
      <div class="counter-sep">·</div>
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="j-min">0</div><div class="counter-name">min</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="counter-since">desde 11 de novembro de 2025 🌹</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Contador separados -->
  <div class="counter-card apart">
    <div class="counter-label">💔 Sem se ver há</div>
    <div class="counter-numbers">
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="s-d">0</div><div class="counter-name">dias</div></div>
      <div class="counter-sep">·</div>
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="s-h">0</div><div class="counter-name">horas</div></div>
      <div class="counter-sep">·</div>
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="s-min">0</div><div class="counter-name">min</div></div>
      <div class="counter-sep">·</div>
      <div class="counter-unit"><div class="counter-num" id="s-sec">0</div><div class="counter-name">seg</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="counter-since">desde 23 de janeiro de 2026 🥺</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Fotos strip -->
  <div class="photo-strip" id="photo-strip"></div>

  <!-- Música -->
  <div class="music-card">
    <div class="music-disc" id="music-disc">🎵</div>
    <div class="music-wave" id="music-wave"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
    <div class="music-text">
      <div class="music-title">Poesia Acústica #2 — Sobre Nós</div>
      <div class="music-sub">Delacruz · Maria · Ducon · BK' e outros</div>
    </div>
    <button class="music-btn" id="music-btn" onclick="toggleMusic()">▶</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Chat -->
  <div class="chat-wrap">
    <div class="chat-header">
      <div class="chat-avatar">🌹</div>
      <div style="flex:1">
        <div class="chat-name-h">Maria</div>
        <div class="chat-online" id="online-status">● conectando...</div>
      </div>
      <div class="chat-call-btns">
        <button class="call-btn audio" onclick="startCall('audio')" title="Chamada de voz">📞</button>
        <button class="call-btn video" onclick="startCall('video')" title="Vídeo chamada">📹</button>
      </div>
      <div class="conn-dot" id="conn-dot"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="chat-messages" id="chat-messages">
      <div style="text-align:center;font-size:.75rem;color:#c0395a55;font-style:italic;padding:20px 0">Carregando mensagens... 💕</div>
    </div>
    <div class="chat-input-bar">
      <div class="chat-photo-btn" title="Enviar foto">
        📷<input type="file" accept="image/*" onchange="sendPhoto(event)">
      </div>
      <input class="chat-input" id="chat-input" placeholder="Mensagem..." onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){sendChat();event.preventDefault();}">
      <button class="chat-send" onclick="sendChat()">➤</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script type="module">
import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-app.js";
import { getDatabase, ref, push, onChildAdded, serverTimestamp, onValue, set, onDisconnect, get, remove }
  from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-database.js";
import { getFirestore, doc, setDoc, onSnapshot, deleteDoc, getDoc }
  from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js";

const firebaseConfig = { databaseURL: "https://my-love-145ae-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/", projectId: "my-love-145ae" };
const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const db = getDatabase(app);
const fs = getFirestore(app);

// ── WHO AM I ──
let whoAmI = 'me';
let myPresenceId = 'user_' + Date.now();

window.setWho = w => {
  whoAmI = w;
  document.getElementById('who-me').classList.toggle('active', w==='me');
  document.getElementById('who-her').classList.toggle('active', w==='her');
};

// ── PRESENCE ──
const presRef = ref(db, 'chat/presence/' + myPresenceId);
set(presRef, { who: whoAmI, online: true, ts: Date.now() });
onDisconnect(presRef).remove();

onValue(ref(db, 'chat/presence'), snap => {
  const users = snap.exists() ? Object.values(snap.val()) : [];
  const n = users.length;
  const otherOnline = users.some(u => u.who !== whoAmI);
  document.getElementById('online-status').textContent =
    n >= 2 ? '● vocês dois estão online 💕' : n === 1 ? '● você está online' : '● offline';
  if(otherOnline && window._lastOtherOnline === false) {
    showToast('💕', 'Maria entrou online!');
    sendNotification('Maria entrou online! 💕', 'Ela está aqui no app agora.');
  }
  window._lastOtherOnline = otherOnline;
});

// ── CONNECTION ──
onValue(ref(db, '.info/connected'), snap => {
  document.getElementById('conn-dot').classList.toggle('ok', !!snap.val());
});

// ── CHAT MESSAGES ──
const msgRef = ref(db, 'chat/messages');
let firstLoad = true;
const box = document.getElementById('chat-messages');

window._fbSend = (text, who) => push(msgRef, { text, who, type:'text', ts: serverTimestamp() });
window._fbSendPhoto = (b64, who) => push(msgRef, { text: b64, who, type:'image', ts: serverTimestamp() });

onChildAdded(msgRef, snap => {
  const d = snap.val(); if(!d) return;
  if(firstLoad){ box.innerHTML=''; firstLoad=false; }
  const now = d.ts ? new Date(d.ts) : new Date();
  const time = now.getHours().toString().padStart(2,'0')+':'+now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0');
  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.className = 'msg ' + (d.who==='me'?'me':'her');
  const sender = d.who==='her' ? '<div class="msg-sender">Maria 🌹</div>' : '';
  if(d.type==='image'){
    wrap.innerHTML=`${sender}<div class="msg-bubble"><img src="${d.text}" onclick="openLB('${d.text}')"></div><div class="msg-time">${time}</div>`;
  } else {
    wrap.innerHTML=`${sender}<div class="msg-bubble">${esc(d.text)}</div><div class="msg-time">${time}</div>`;
  }
  box.appendChild(wrap);
  box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;

  // Notify if message from other
  if(!firstLoad && d.who !== whoAmI) {
    const preview = d.type==='image' ? '📸 Foto' : d.text.substring(0,40);
    showToast('💬', preview);
    sendNotification('Nova mensagem 💬', d.type==='image' ? '📸 Enviou uma foto' : d.text);
  }
});

function esc(t){ return t.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }

// ── NOTIFICATIONS ──
async function requestNotifPermission(){
  if('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'default'){
    await Notification.requestPermission();
  }
}
requestNotifPermission();

window.sendNotification = (title, body) => {
  if('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'granted' && document.hidden){
    new Notification(title, { body, icon: '❤️' });
  }
};

// ── WEBRTC CALL ──
let localStream = null, peerConn = null, callTimerInt = null, callSecs = 0;
let currentCallType = 'audio', isCaller = false, muted = false, camOff = false;

const iceServers = { iceServers:[{urls:'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302'},{urls:'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'}] };

async function getMedia(video){
  try {
    return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio:true, video });
  } catch(e) {
    showToast('❌', 'Não foi possível acessar microfone/câmera');
    return null;
  }
}

window.startCall = async (type) => {
  currentCallType = type; isCaller = true;
  localStream = await getMedia(type === 'video');
  if(!localStream) return;

  if(type==='video'){
    const lv = document.getElementById('local-video');
    lv.srcObject = localStream; lv.style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('btn-cam').style.display='flex';
  }

  peerConn = new RTCPeerConnection(iceServers);
  localStream.getTracks().forEach(t => peerConn.addTrack(t, localStream));

  peerConn.ontrack = e => {
    const rv = document.getElementById('remote-video');
    rv.srcObject = e.streams[0];
    rv.style.display = type==='video' ? 'block' : 'none';
  };

  peerConn.onicecandidate = async e => {
    if(e.candidate) {
      await setDoc(doc(fs, 'calls', 'signal', 'caller_candidates', Date.now().toString()), e.candidate.toJSON());
    }
  };

  const offer = await peerConn.createOffer();
  await peerConn.setLocalDescription(offer);

  await setDoc(doc(fs, 'calls', 'active'), {
    type, status:'calling', offer: { type: offer.type, sdp: offer.sdp }, ts: Date.now()
  });

  showCallOverlay('chamando...', type);

  // Listen for answer
  onSnapshot(doc(fs, 'calls', 'active'), async snap => {
    if(!snap.exists()) { hangUp(); return; }
    const data = snap.data();
    if(data.status==='answered' && data.answer && peerConn && !peerConn.currentRemoteDescription){
      await peerConn.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.answer));
      document.getElementById('call-status').textContent='em chamada 💕';
      document.getElementById('call-timer').style.display='block';
      startCallTimer();
    }
    if(data.status==='declined' || data.status==='ended'){ hangUp(); }
  });

  // Listen for callee ICE candidates
  onSnapshot(doc(fs, 'calls', 'signal', 'callee_candidates', 'dummy'), ()=>{});
  // Use subcollection listener
  const { collection, onSnapshot: onSnap2 } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js");
  onSnap2(collection(fs, 'calls','signal','callee_candidates'), snap2 => {
    snap2.docChanges().forEach(async change => {
      if(change.type==='added' && peerConn){
        await peerConn.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(change.doc.data()));
      }
    });
  });
};

// Listen for incoming call
onSnapshot(doc(fs, 'calls', 'active'), async snap => {
  if(!snap.exists() || isCaller) return;
  const data = snap.data();
  if(data.status==='calling'){
    document.getElementById('incoming-sub').textContent = 'Chamada de ' + (data.type==='video' ? '📹 vídeo' : '📞 voz') + ' entrando...';
    document.getElementById('incoming-call').classList.add('open');
    sendNotification('📞 Chamada entrando!', data.type==='video'?'Videochamada':'Chamada de voz');
    showToast('📞', 'Chamada entrando! Toque para atender.');
    window._incomingCallData = data;
    currentCallType = data.type;
  }
});

window.acceptCall = async () => {
  document.getElementById('incoming-call').classList.remove('open');
  const data = window._incomingCallData;
  localStream = await getMedia(data.type==='video');
  if(!localStream) return;

  if(data.type==='video'){
    const lv = document.getElementById('local-video');
    lv.srcObject = localStream; lv.style.display='block';
    document.getElementById('btn-cam').style.display='flex';
  }

  peerConn = new RTCPeerConnection(iceServers);
  localStream.getTracks().forEach(t => peerConn.addTrack(t, localStream));

  peerConn.ontrack = e => {
    const rv = document.getElementById('remote-video');
    rv.srcObject = e.streams[0];
    rv.style.display = data.type==='video' ? 'block' : 'none';
  };

  const { collection, onSnapshot: onSnap3 } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js");
  peerConn.onicecandidate = async e => {
    if(e.candidate){
      await setDoc(doc(fs, 'calls','signal','callee_candidates', Date.now().toString()), e.candidate.toJSON());
    }
  };

  await peerConn.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.offer));
  const answer = await peerConn.createAnswer();
  await peerConn.setLocalDescription(answer);

  await setDoc(doc(fs, 'calls','active'), { ...data, status:'answered', answer:{ type:answer.type, sdp:answer.sdp } });

  showCallOverlay('em chamada 💕', data.type);
  document.getElementById('call-timer').style.display='block';
  startCallTimer();

  // Listen for caller ICE
  onSnap3(collection(fs,'calls','signal','caller_candidates'), snap2 => {
    snap2.docChanges().forEach(async change => {
      if(change.type==='added' && peerConn){
        await peerConn.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(change.doc.data()));
      }
    });
  });
};

window.declineCall = async () => {
  document.getElementById('incoming-call').classList.remove('open');
  await setDoc(doc(fs,'calls','active'), { status:'declined' });
};

window.hangUp = async () => {
  if(peerConn){ peerConn.close(); peerConn=null; }
  if(localStream){ localStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); localStream=null; }
  clearInterval(callTimerInt); callSecs=0; isCaller=false;
  document.getElementById('call-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('local-video').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('remote-video').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('remote-video').srcObject=null;
  document.getElementById('call-timer').style.display='none';
  try{ await deleteDoc(doc(fs,'calls','active')); }catch(e){}
};

window.toggleMute = () => {
  muted = !muted;
  if(localStream) localStream.getAudioTracks().forEach(t => t.enabled = !muted);
  document.getElementById('btn-mute').textContent = muted ? '🔇' : '🎤';
};

window.toggleCam = () => {
  camOff = !camOff;
  if(localStream) localStream.getVideoTracks().forEach(t => t.enabled = !camOff);
  document.getElementById('btn-cam').textContent = camOff ? '📵' : '📷';
};

function showCallOverlay(status, type){
  document.getElementById('call-overlay').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('call-status').textContent = status;
}

function startCallTimer(){
  callSecs=0;
  callTimerInt = setInterval(()=>{
    callSecs++;
    const m=Math.floor(callSecs/60).toString().padStart(2,'0');
    const s=(callSecs%60).toString().padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('call-timer').textContent = m+':'+s;
  },1000);
}

// ── PHOTO SEND ──
window.sendPhoto = e => {
  const file = e.target.files[0]; if(!file) return;
  e.target.value='';
  const loadDiv = document.createElement('div');
  loadDiv.className='msg '+(whoAmI==='me'?'me':'her');
  loadDiv.innerHTML='<div class="uploading"><div class="upload-spin"></div> Enviando foto...</div>';
  box.appendChild(loadDiv); box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight;
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = ev => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
      let w=img.width,h=img.height;
      if(w>800){h=h*800/w;w=800;}
      canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h;
      canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
      loadDiv.remove();
      window._fbSendPhoto(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.7), whoAmI);
    };
    img.src=ev.target.result;
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
};

window.sendChat = () => {
  const inp=document.getElementById('chat-input');
  const txt=inp.value.trim(); if(!txt) return;
  inp.value='';
  window._fbSend(txt, whoAmI);
};

window.openLB = src => { document.getElementById('lb-img').src=src; document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('open'); };
</script>

<script>
// ── ASSETS (injected below) ──
const PHOTOS = [
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
];
const MP3_SRC = "data:audio/mpeg;base64,";

// ── BG SLIDESHOW ──
const bgs = document.getElementById('bg-slideshow');
PHOTOS.forEach((src,i)=>{
  const d=document.createElement('div');
  d.className='bg-slide'+(i===0?' active':'');
  d.style.backgroundImage=`url(${src})`;
  bgs.appendChild(d);
});
let bgIdx=0;
setInterval(()=>{
  const slides=document.querySelectorAll('.bg-slide');
  slides[bgIdx].classList.remove('active');
  bgIdx=(bgIdx+1)%slides.length;
  slides[bgIdx].classList.add('active');
},4000);

// ── PHOTO STRIP ──
const strip=document.getElementById('photo-strip');
PHOTOS.forEach(src=>{
  const img=document.createElement('img');
  img.src=src;
  img.onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('lb-img').src=src;document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('open');};
  strip.appendChild(img);
});

// ── PETALS ──
const pc=document.getElementById('petals');
for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
  const p=document.createElement('div');p.className='petal';
  p.style.cssText=`left:${Math.random()*100}%;width:${6+Math.random()*8}px;height:${8+Math.random()*12}px;animation-duration:${5+Math.random()*7}s;animation-delay:${Math.random()*10}s;`;
  pc.appendChild(p);
}

// ── COUNTERS ──
function updateCounters(){
  const start=new Date(2025,10,11),apart=new Date(2026,0,23),now=new Date();
  let a=now.getFullYear()-start.getFullYear(),m=now.getMonth()-start.getMonth(),d=now.getDate()-start.getDate();
  if(d<0){m--;d+=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),0).getDate();}
  if(m<0){a--;m+=12;}
  document.getElementById('j-a').textContent=a;
  document.getElementById('j-m').textContent=m;
  document.getElementById('j-d').textContent=d;
  document.getElementById('j-h').textContent=now.getHours();
  document.getElementById('j-min').textContent=now.getMinutes();
  const diff=now-apart;
  document.getElementById('s-d').textContent=Math.floor(diff/86400000);
  document.getElementById('s-h').textContent=Math.floor((diff%86400000)/3600000);
  document.getElementById('s-min').textContent=Math.floor((diff%3600000)/60000);
  document.getElementById('s-sec').textContent=Math.floor((diff%60000)/1000);
}
updateCounters();setInterval(updateCounters,1000);

// ── MUSIC ──
const audio = new Audio(MP3_SRC);
audio.loop=true;
let musicOn=false;
function toggleMusic(){
  if(musicOn){audio.pause();musicOn=false;}
  else{audio.play();musicOn=true;}
  document.getElementById('music-btn').textContent=musicOn?'⏸':'▶';
  document.getElementById('music-disc').classList.toggle('spinning',musicOn);
  document.getElementById('music-wave').className='music-wave'+(musicOn?' on':'');
}
window.toggleMusic=toggleMusic;

// ── TOAST ──
let toastTimer;
window.showToast=(icon,text)=>{
  document.getElementById('toast-icon').textContent=icon;
  document.getElementById('toast-text').textContent=text;
  document.getElementById('toast').classList.add('open');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('toast').classList.remove('open'),4000);
};
window.closeToast=()=>document.getElementById('toast').classList.remove('open');

// ── HEART BURST ──
document.getElementById('heart-icon').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const em=['❤️','💕','💖','💗','🌹','✨'];
  const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='burst';c.style.left=e.clientX+'px';c.style.top=e.clientY+'px';
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    const h=document.createElement('div');h.className='burst-heart';h.textContent=em[Math.floor(Math.random()*em.length)];
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,dist=60+Math.random()*90;
    h.style.setProperty('--dx',Math.cos(a)*dist+'px');h.style.setProperty('--dy',Math.sin(a)*dist+'px');
    h.style.animationDelay=Math.random()*.15+'s';c.appendChild(h);
  }
  document.body.appendChild(c);setTimeout(()=>c.remove(),1300);
});
</script>

<script>
if('serviceWorker' in navigator){
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js')
      .then(r => console.log('SW registered'))
      .catch(e => console.log('SW error', e));
  });
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
